rule: Artifact freshness must distinguish fresh execution evidence from fresh wrappers around stale work.
why: A system can appear alive by publishing new summaries while the underlying execution evidence is old. That creates false confidence and stalls recovery.

evidence_trust_rank_order.meaning: Direct UI/API/scheduler/dispatcher path executed and produced the expected visible result.
Focused test or runtime validation proved the requested behavior.
Relevant source files changed and diff maps to requested behavior.
Runtime state changed, but behavior may still need live-path proof.
A summary or latest artifact described work; not sufficient for completion by itself.

operator_summary: MIM/TOD must report whether evidence is actually fresh or only newly summarized. New wrapper timestamps cannot rescue stale execution proof.
